description: This file implements a service class 'DeepSeekLLMService' that extends 'OpenAILLMService' to interact with DeepSeek's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It includes methods for initializing the service, creating a client, and building chat completion parameters specific to DeepSeek.

classes.name: DeepSeekLLMService
classes.description: A specialized service class for interacting with DeepSeek's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. Extends 'OpenAILLMService' and customizes client creation and chat request parameters.

methods.description: Constructs request parameters for DeepSeek chat completion, overriding defaults from OpenAI to suit DeepSeek's API specifications such as disabling unsupported parameters.
